title: Oldsmobile Cutlass Engines by Year (1961–1999)
description: Every factory engine in the Oldsmobile Cutlass, 442 and Cutlass Supreme by year, 1961–1999: the Jetfire turbo, the 400 and 455 W-30, Olds V8s and V6s.
intro: The Cutlass name ran on Oldsmobile's compact and mid-size cars from 1961 to 1999, and covered the 442, the Hurst/Olds and several later front-drive lines. The 442 began as an option package and was a separate model for 1968–1971; the trims column shows which engines it got.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The first F-85 and Cutlass used Oldsmobile's aluminum 215 V8, and the 1962–1963 Jetfire added a turbocharger.

From 1964 the Cutlass used Oldsmobile's cast-iron V8s: the 330, then the 350, with the 400 in the 442 and, from 1968, the 455. The W-30 package was the top 442 engine. Ratings are gross through 1971 and SAE net from 1972.
The Colonnade Cutlass carried SAE net ratings and Oldsmobile's 260, 350 and 455, with the 403 arriving for 1977.

The downsized rear-drive Cutlass Supreme, Salon, Calais and Cruiser used Buick V6s, Oldsmobile's 260, 307 and 350 V8s, and Oldsmobile diesels; the 1985–1987 4-4-2 used a 307. The front-drive Cutlass Ciera arrived in 1982 and the Cutlass Calais in 1985.
The front-drive Cutlass Supreme replaced the rear-drive car after 1988. The Ciera, Calais and the 1997–1999 Cutlass used GM fours and V6s, including Oldsmobile's Quad 4.

notes.1982|307|140: Cruiser wagon only. Published ratings for this engine vary.

1965|330|250.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1965 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1965|330|250.says: '330 CID 2-Barrel V-8' 250 @ 4800; standard in Cutlass, available on F-85 V8 models (the F-85 Deluxe Sports Coupe was V6-only).

1965|330|315.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1965 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1965|330|315.says: '330 CID 4-Barrel V-8' 315 @ 5200; optional on Cutlass and F-85.

1966|330|310.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1966 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1966|330|310.says: '330 CID 4-Barrel Low Compression V-8' 310 @ 5200; Cutlass: 'The 250 HP 330 CID V-8 was standard with the 320 HO version optional as well as a regular fuel 310 version'; F-85 option '310 horsepower 330 CID V-8 ($33)'.

1968|350|250.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1968 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1968|350|250.says: '350 CID 2-Barrel V-8' 250 @ 4400; base V8 for F-85, Cutlass and Cutlass Supreme.

1969|350|250.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1969 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1969|350|250.says: '350 CID 2-Barrel V-8' 250 @ 4400 in the 1969 F-85/Cutlass line.

1970|350|250.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1970 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1970|350|250.says: '350 CID 2-Barrel V-8' 250 hp, base V8 across the F-85/Cutlass line.

1971|250|145.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1971 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1971|250|145.says: 250 CID I-6 145 hp in F-85/Cutlass line; final year for the six.

1971|350|240.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1971 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1971|350|240.says: 350 CID 2-bbl 240 hp, standard V8 for Cutlass and Cutlass Supreme.

1971|350|260.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1971 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1971|350|260.says: 350 CID 4-bbl 260 hp, available on F-85, Cutlass and Cutlass Supreme.

1972|455|250.name: Over-Drive Magazine - 1972 Oldsmobile Mid-Size Cars Fact Sheet
1972|455|250.says: '455 CID L75 V-8' 250 SAE net @ 4200; '455 cubic inch 250 horsepower L-75 V-8 engine in F-85 only ($188)'; optional on other mid-size models.

1985|262|85.name: Diesel World magazine - Diesel History Retrospective: The LT7 Front-Drive V-6 (Oldsmobile's other diesel)
1985|262|85.says: 4.3 V6 diesel 'Introduced in 1982'; GM phased out all diesel cars after the 1985 model year; 'The LT6 was an all-iron engine designed for the rear-drive G-body cars (Buick Regal, Chevy Malibu and Monte Carlo, Olds Cutlass Supreme and Cutlass Calais)'; 85 hp @ 3,600. Gives the 1982-85 range, not a per-model year.
